title: Sheet Pan Chicken and Potatoes (Five Ingredients)
reject_reason: Ranch/garlic/parmesan chicken and baby potatoes on a sheet pan is the same chicken+potato+parmesan sheet-pan dinner as live parmesan-garlic-sheet-pan-chicken-potatoes (easy-chicken-and-potatoes and parmesan-crusted-chicken-sheet-pan already rejected the same way); ranch is a seasoning nuance.
